Keep-aware multinomial log-density for OSA residuals

dmultinom_osa.Rd

Computes the multinomial log-density of a single composition using the conditional decomposition required by oneStepPredict. Following Trijoulet et al. (2023) and WHAM (src/age_comp_osa.hpp), an \(A\)-bin multinomial is written as \(A - 1\) conditional two-category multinomials, each gated by its keep element. The final bin is fixed by the sum-to-\(N\) constraint and contributes nothing (its residual is undefined and reported as NA).

Usage

dmultinom_osa(xobs, p, log = TRUE)

Arguments

xobs

Either an object of class "osa" supplied by oneStepPredict, or a plain numeric vector of observed counts (length \(A\)) during ordinary fitting.

p

Predicted proportions (length \(A\)); normalized internally.

log

Boolean on whether to return nLL

Value

Scalar log-density contribution for the composition.

Details

With all keep equal to one, the sum of the conditional log-densities equals the joint multinomial log-density; enabling OSA therefore changes how the likelihood is decomposed, not its value. The running remainder is frozen to the observed total (see osa_extract_values) so that peeling a late bin cannot drive the remaining count negative.

Intended for use with method = "oneStepGeneric"; the two-category conditionals carry no analytic CDF hooks, so the "cdf" method is not supported (consistent with WHAM, which omits it for compositions).
